name: The kill targets of Oh, the Places You'll Go (611/612) and Duo Delirium (613/614) are spawned
contract: Hardcore - Oh, the Places You'll Go (611, Prestige 612) requires killing Blackfathom Ascendant 774803 before level 21, Son of Arugal 772529 before 22, Cahooey the Big 610896 before 29, Myrrkora Wavebind 449327 before 43, Thar'zul 107028 before 57 and Construct Surgeon 918530 before 57; none of them existed, so the trial could not be completed. Nightmare - Duo Delirium (613, 614) requires Yil'da 255146 before 44, who had a template but no spawn. Their names, ranks, displays and cached health modifiers come from the Ascension client creature cache; levels, spawn points, factions, abilities and loot are estimated from the base creature whose entry the id ends in. Each target is asserted from the world phase at its spawn: it is there once at its level with its cached display and can be attacked. Health is asserted within 5% of base health times the cached modifier, which is what remains after the open-world health scaling that trial targets do not receive on Ascension is divided out: tight enough to catch a creature left at the scaled or unscaled value, loose enough for rounding. Like the Trollbane Paragons scenario, the health checks need the live open-world scaling: CoA.CreatureScaling.Enable = 1 as in coa.conf.dist, which a test server without module configs lacks (set AC_CO_A_CREATURE_SCALING_ENABLE=1).
